Title: What to do with those Camarilla Edition Booster Wrappers

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Stolen without permission from www.vtesinla.org

*********** From Lisa Charlton via the v:ekn prince list...*********

As you may or may not be aware of at this point there is an offer in
each
Camarilla start Deck for a free T-shirt. I had a few questions sent to
me
that seemed better to answer on this list than each person
individually.

First off the offer it self:

1. Collect whole wrappers from new V:TES Booster packs.

Collect 40 for a T-shirt; 75 for a sweatshirt-or multiple thereof for
more
shirts. ( You can choose from clan T-shirts)
2. Cut this form out and fill it out and send it in to White Wolf with
your collected wrappers.

Some questions asked were:

1. How much is a limited offer?

Basically this offer is only limited on the type of T-shirt you want.
For
example if you would like a Toreador T-shirt and we are out of stock
we will substitute that shirt with another we have in stock. Basically
you will always get a shirt, but at times we may not be able to fill
specific
requests.

2. Is it possible to turn those wrappers at a translator/distributor
in?

No we're perfectly happy to ship those directly to you anywhere in the
world.

3. Can princes take part?

Absolutely!

Lisa M. Charlton
Retail Relations
White Wolf Publishing Inc.

FREE SHIRT OFFER!!!
For Vampire: The Eternal Struggle

Wear your clan (and brand) loyalty right on your
chest with this Free Shirt Offer from White Wolf

can earn yourself one or more free Vampire: The
Masquerade(R) T-shirts and/or sweatshirts.

Here's All You Have To Do:

1.) Collect whole wrappers from new Vampire: The
Eternal Struggle(R) booster packs. (40 for a T-shirt, 75
for a sweatshirt -- or multiples thereof for more
shirts)

2.) Either cut out or photocopy this form, and fill it
out.

3.) Mail the form and your collected wrappers to:
White Wolf Publishing, Inc.

USA

That's all! The only catch is that you have to act
